installCommand: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && mkdir -p .tools/foundry-linux && curl --fail --location --output /tmp/foundry.tar.gz https://github.com/foundry-rs/foundry/releases/download/v1.7.1/foundry_v1.7.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz && echo 'cf7e688ed0c4c48adffca788b496076e31060b67ac5afe1e43dbb5499c20c88b  /tmp/foundry.tar.gz' | sha256sum --check --status && tar --extract --gzip --file /tmp/foundry.tar.gz --directory .tools/foundry-linux && .tools/foundry-linux/forge install foundry-rs/forge-std@v1.16.2 --root contracts --no-git --shallow && if [ "$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)" = "true" ]; then git fetch --unshallow; fi
